verdict.rationale: RustDesk Server Pro documents a management API and per-user and device-group access control. Neither shows that you can issue scoped or least-privilege API credentials, such as limited-permission tokens, for an agent. Access control over users and devices is an adjacent feature, not scoped API credential issuance, so the applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
